CHAPTER  V
CARRIAGE  BY  AIR  PERFORMED  BY  A  PERSON  OTHER  THAN
THE  CONTRACTING  CARRIER
Article  39  -  Contracting  Carrier  -  Actual  Carrier
The  provisions  of  this  Chapter  apply  when  a  person  (hereinafter

column1: referred  to  as  “the  contracting  carrier”)  as  a  principal  makes  a  contract
of  carriage  governed  by  this  Convention  with  a  passenger  or  consignor
or  with  a  person  acting  on  behalf  of  the  passenger  or  consignor,  and
another  person  (hereinafter  referred  to  as  “the  actual  carrier”)  performs,
by  virtue  of  authority  from  the  contracting  carrier,  the  whole  or  part  of
the  carriage,  but  is  not  with  respect  to  such  part  a  successive  carrier
within the meaning of this Convention. Such authority shall be presumed
in  the  absence  of  proof  to  the  contrary.

If  an  actual  carrier  performs  the  whole  or  part  of  carriage  which,

this  Convention,  the  former  for  the  whole  of  the  carriage  contemplated
in  the  contract,  the  latter  solely  for  the  carriage  which  it  performs.
